# feat: PWA — installable app with offline shell and tile caching

**Date:** 2026-05-27  
**Category:** feat  
**Files:** `vite.config.ts`, `index.html`, `src/index.css`, `public/`

## What was added

### Icons (`public/`)
Four PNG icons generated from the UW red "P" badge design:
- `icon-192.png` — Android home screen / Chrome install prompt
- `icon-512.png` — Android splash screen & maskable
- `apple-touch-icon.png` (180×180) — iOS "Add to Home Screen"
- `favicon-32.png` — browser tab favicon

### Web App Manifest (generated by `vite-plugin-pwa`)
- `name`: UW Parking, `short_name`: UW Parking
- `display: standalone` — opens without browser chrome
- `theme_color: #c5050c` (UW red) — colours the Android status bar
- `background_color: #0f1720` — splash screen background while JS loads
- `start_url: /`

### Service Worker (Workbox via `vite-plugin-pwa`)
- **Precaches** the entire app shell (HTML, JS, CSS, fonts, icons) at build time.
  The app loads instantly and works offline after the first visit.
- **Mapbox tiles** (`a–d.tiles.mapbox.com`) — `CacheFirst`, 30-day TTL, 500 entries.
  Once a campus area is viewed, tiles load offline.
- **Mapbox API** (styles, glyphs, sprites) — `StaleWhileRevalidate`, 7-day TTL.
- **Google Fonts** — `CacheFirst`, 1-year TTL.
- **`/api/uw-parking`** — intentionally excluded from all caching. Live parking
  data is always fetched from the network; the existing stale/fallback UI handles
  network failures gracefully.
- `registerType: autoUpdate` — new deploys silently update the SW and reload.

### `index.html` meta tags
- `theme-color` (UW red) for Android Chrome tab bar
- `apple-mobile-web-app-capable` + `apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style`
  for full-screen mode on iOS
- `apple-touch-icon` link for iOS home screen icon
- `viewport-fit=cover` for edge-to-edge on notched iPhones

### Safe area insets (`src/index.css`)
Overlay and locate button use `env(safe-area-inset-*)` so they don't
overlap the notch or home indicator on iPhone X and newer.

## How to install
- **Android/Chrome**: tap "Add to Home Screen" in the browser menu, or wait
  for the automatic install prompt.
- **iOS/Safari**: tap the Share sheet → "Add to Home Screen".
- **Desktop Chrome/Edge**: click the install icon in the address bar.

## Dependencies added
- `vite-plugin-pwa` (devDependency) — Workbox-based PWA plugin for Vite.
